summary_en: Raman asked about ordering 200 matte visiting cards and requested pricing and delivery details. The agent quoted ₹350 per 100 cards, totaling ₹700 for 200 cards, confirmed the 100-card minimum, and stated delivery in Vijayawada would take 3 working days after artwork approval; urgent delivery would cost an additional ₹150. Raman clarified that he only wanted visiting cards and was asking about wedding card pricing for information, not to place a wedding card order. The agent thanked him and ended the call. No order was confirmed.
next_action: Do not contact this number. The caller opted out.
notes: Caller mentioned wedding cards only as an information query and explicitly said he was not ordering them. The transcript does not confirm that the visiting card order was placed.
